sysname R2-BORDER

acl number 2000
 rule 5 permit source 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
#
acl number 3100
 rule 5 permit tcp destination 10.0.0.1 0 destination-port eq 22
 rule 10 deny ip
#
acl name MGMT basic
 rule 5 permit source 10.10.10.10 0
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.252
 traffic-filter inbound acl 3100
 traffic-filter outbound acl name MGMT
#
interface LoopBack0
 ip address 2.2.2.2 255.255.255.255
#
ospf 1 router-id 2.2.2.2
 import-route direct cost 10
 area 0.0.0.0
  network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3
#
rip 1
 version 2
 undo summary
 silent-interface LoopBack0
 network 172.16.0.0
 import-route static cost 3
#
bgp 65002
 router-id 2.2.2.2
 peer 10.0.0.1 as-number 65001
 #
 ipv4-family unicast
  undo synchronization
  network 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.0
  import-route direct med 50
  peer 10.0.0.1 enable
#
ntp-service unicast-server 10.9.9.1
info-center loghost 10.9.9.2
#
stelnet server enable
user-interface vty 0 4
 authentication-mode aaa
 protocol inbound ssh
